X.note: Strong CGI street with convincing peeling plaster and balconies. The crowd is made of stiff, mannequin-like figures in pale, washed-out colours, with identical poses. Figures are lit flatly and don't match the scene's lighting. The foreground soldiers are plain, untextured shapes. The Union Jack on the pole is tiny, and the harbour and ship are generic.

Y.note: Same environment as X. The figures are slightly darker and more varied in uniform tone, and the foreground soldiers show some webbing and kit detail. They still look like game-asset mannequins, in clumped groups with stiff poses. Scale and grounding are slightly better, but it is still not convincing.

why: The environments are identical, but Y's crowd has slightly more tonal variety and kit detail and looks a little less like toy figures.
top_fix_for_weaker: Re-render the crowd in X with varied poses and spacing, darker khaki and navy uniforms with proper shading, and contact shadows. Remove the identical pale figures so they stop reading as mannequins.
anachronisms_seen: Pristine, uniform window shutters and ironwork look more modern than wartime wear
Clean, mannequin-like uniforms with no insignia, webbing or period headgear detail
No wartime signage, sandbags or blackout markings on a September 1943 Gibraltar street
